title: Bits and byte order
hints: `std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(f)` (from `<bit>`) gives the bits of a float in one call. `std::memcpy(&value, &f, 4)` does the same in older code.
Big-endian means byte 0 is the top 8 bits: shift it left by 24, byte 1 by 16, byte 2 by 8, and combine with `|`.
rules: Copy the bytes with std::memcpy or std::bit_cast instead of casting the pointer.

rules.message: Copy the bytes with std::memcpy or std::bit_cast instead of casting the pointer.
